description: Memphis Area Transit Authority (MATA) Routes is a dataset listed in Datamidsouth open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by City of Memphis. This dataset provides detailed information on the transit routes operated by the Memphis Area Transit Authority (MATA). It includes data such as route names, identifiers, and geometric representations of each route's path. Coverage: Memphis and the Mid-South. The portal files it under Geography, Transportation. Its keywords are MATA, Transportation, Bus, Routes, Public Transportation, Green. The portal shows 68 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2025-06-04 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-www-datamidsouth-org-portal.
